capabilities: Highlight exact selections in Reading View
Apply six highlight colours via toolbar or shortcuts
Search, recolour, remove and merge highlights
Convert older HTML highlights to native ones
Undo highlights from a note navigator
extras: Terminal installer is optional; manual install copies main.js, manifest.json and styles.css. Tag management, footnote annotation creation, quote copying, global research, exports, PDF support and reading progress from the predecessor are no longer included.
problem: Obsidian's built-in highlighting cannot reliably target part of a sentence, list item, or table cell without disturbing surrounding text.

relations.evidence: Reader Highlighter Tags settings are migrated and that plugin is disabled, with its files retained

summary: Highlighter that marks exact text selections in Reading View using surrounding context and saves native coloured highlights.
